summary: Module 8 checkpoint. You grow the golden set to 18 questions and build a script that runs them through the real pipeline and prints one score table with a report and a gate. You run a baseline, find a real retrieval bug in the table, try an obvious fix that makes things worse, find a better one, and compare the whole table. The writer is a labelled stand-in.

items.text: Grow data/golden.jsonl to 18 questions, open every expected page and run check_golden.py
Write scoring.py and run_golden.py and print the table
Write the scoring tests and see them pass
Run the baseline and save the table
Find a failure, say why, try a fix, and compare the whole table before and after
Try --min-pass and read the exit code
Add the README section, then commit and push
